+"""Count log levels in app.log and write the result to report.json."""
+
+import json

+
+BASE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+LOG_FILE = BASE_DIR / "app.log"
+REPORT_FILE = BASE_DIR / "report.json"
+
+LEVEL_PATTERN = re.compile(
+    r"^\s*(DEBUG|INFO|WARN|WARNING|ERROR|FATAL|CRITICAL|TRACE)\b",
+    re.IGNORECASE,
